```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse=TRUE, comment="#>")
library(CCAflow)
```

CCA maximizes the correlation between paired linear combinations of two blocks. Interpretation should combine canonical correlations, coefficients, structure coefficients, cross-loadings, variance extracted and redundancy.

```{r}
d <- cca_agri_data(seed=11)
fit <- cca_classic(d$X, d$Y, ncomp=3)
cca_table(fit, "correlations")
cca_table(fit, "loadings")
cca_table(fit, "redundancy")
```

Classical asymptotic inference is available only for the unregularized classical fit. Permutation and bootstrap provide complementary evidence when their resampling assumptions match the design.

```{r}
inf <- cca_infer(fit)
inf
perm <- cca_permutation(fit, B=99, seed=11)
boot <- cca_bootstrap(fit, B=99, seed=11)
```
